steps.name: Pause Work
steps.description: Pausing, one by one, just the tickets the fix's plan holds while it is built, tested and deployed, and putting the TUI into SELF HEALING — again on every attempt. ASS-418: on the host, so its VM is stopped here

steps.name: Apply Fix
steps.description: Fixing the issue described in the ticket, on its ticket, while the tickets it holds stay paused. ASS-418: on the host, so its VM is stopped here

steps.name: Hand to Human
steps.description: Not fixed — it needs the operator: the ticket goes to Blocked for Human with what they must do, SELF HEALING still held; resolved, it comes back here for another attempt. ASS-418: on the host, so its VM is stopped here

steps.name: Request Restart
steps.description: Asking the harness to restart on the fixed code. ASS-418: on the host, so its VM is stopped here

steps.name: Await Restart
steps.description: Waiting for control and the dashboard to come back on the new code — a minute between asks, half an hour at most. ASS-418: a wait on the host, so its VM is stopped here

steps.name: Resume Work
steps.description: Unpausing the tickets the fix held. ASS-418: on the host, so its VM is stopped here

steps.name: Done
steps.description: The fix is in, or could not be made
